name: dev.lifelogs.unity-windows-api
description: A Unity desktop window control library. Handles monitors, resolutions, display modes, always-on-top, cursor confinement, frame rate and tray icons for PC games, plus borderless, transparent and click-through windows for wallpaper games. One static API, no platform branching in game code.

samples.description: PC game, desktop wallpaper and tray demo scenes. IMGUI based, no Canvas required.
